job.name: D0StandaloneReferenceTune
job.command:
set NEVENTS = 1000 @ PYTHIA_SEED = 1000011 + ${JOBINDEX}
set SCRATCH = `pwd` set PROJECT = /gpfs01/star/pwg/lomicond/Ondrej/Jets/PythiaD0JetGeant/D0EmbeddingClean set OLD_D0WF = /gpfs/mnt/gpfs01/star/pwg/lomicond/Ondrej/Jets/PythiaD0JetGeant/D0EmbeddingClean set BASEJOB = templates/simulation set RUN_LABEL = ReferenceTune_v1
foreach FILE (`grep -rl "${OLD_D0WF}" scripts src templates`) sed -i "s|${OLD_D0WF}|${SCRATCH}|g" ${FILE} end
cp "${FILELIST}" "${BASEJOB}/mudst.selected.list"
# Start from the same validated production wrapper as the Detroit job. # Give both generated work trees unique names and change only the tune file. cp scripts/run_standalone_production_v3.csh run_standalone_production_reference_batch.csh sed -i "s|evts_simulation_v1|evts_simulation_referenceTune_v1|g" run_standalone_production_reference_batch.csh sed -i "s|evts_standalone_v1|evts_standalone_referenceTune_v1|g" run_standalone_production_reference_batch.csh sed -i "s|pythia8_detroit_v1.cmnd|pythia8_reference_effective.cmnd|g" run_standalone_production_reference_batch.csh
grep -q "pythia8_reference_effective.cmnd" run_standalone_production_reference_batch.csh if ( $status != 0 ) then echo "ERROR: reference tune was not selected" exit 81 endif
grep -q "pythia8_detroit_v1.cmnd" run_standalone_production_reference_batch.csh if ( $status == 0 ) then echo "ERROR: Detroit tune is still referenced by the control wrapper" exit 82 endif
set RUNLOG = "${PROJECT}/log/D0JetStandalone_${RUN_LABEL}_j${JOBINDEX}_s${PYTHIA_SEED}_n${NEVENTS}.log"
tcsh run_standalone_production_reference_batch.csh ${NEVENTS} 1 0 ${PYTHIA_SEED} >&! "${RUNLOG}" set RUN_STATUS = $status
if ( ${RUN_STATUS} != 0 ) then exit ${RUN_STATUS} endif
set PICO = work/jobs/st_physics_15130045_raw_1000011_${NEVENTS}evts_standalone_referenceTune_v1/pico/st_physics_15130045_raw_1000011.picoDst.root set FINALPICO = "${PROJECT}/production/D0JetStandalone_${RUN_LABEL}_j${JOBINDEX}_s${PYTHIA_SEED}_n${NEVENTS}.picoDst.root"
if ( ! -s "${PICO}" ) then echo "ERROR: final PicoDst is missing: ${PICO}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 90 endif
cp "${PICO}" "${FINALPICO}" set COPY_STATUS = $status
if ( ${COPY_STATUS} != 0 || ! -s "${FINALPICO}" ) then echo "ERROR: failed to save final PicoDst: ${FINALPICO}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 91 endif
echo "FINALPICO=${FINALPICO}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 0
